findings.message: The client-supplied file name is interpolated into a shell command run with shell=True, so a name like `x; rm -rf ~` executes arbitrary commands. The name is also not confined to UPLOAD_DIR, so `../` or an absolute path reads or writes files outside it.
findings.suggestion: subprocess.run(["convert", str(UPLOAD_DIR / client_name), "-resize", "128x128", str(UPLOAD_DIR / target)], check=True)

findings.message: `client_name` is used as a path without validation. Path separators or `..` let a client reach files outside the upload directory. A leading `-` could also be read by convert as an option.
This new behaviour comes without a test. The repository requires a test with every behaviour change.
